metadata.notes: The box rename's test on mGBA: Box 1 (the box the PC opens on) from BOX1 to a name of symbols and back. Starts facing Route 4 Pokémon Center's PC, from a save whose Box 1 is BOX1, and ends there.

checkpoint.title: Box 1 renamed Az!…'.,9 and back to BOX1

events.why: Eight characters from all three pages of the naming screen, a symbol and the ellipsis among them, typed and read back from the box title.
Back to the name the save had, so the checkpoint ends where it started.
